notes.scope: Named raft craftables that are shell pieces, shelters, production stations, utility stations, or defenses. Excludes boats, weapons, the Wrench tool, and potion recipes. Unnamed day-multiplier crafts from incomplete tables are omitted.
notes.resourceLabel: Public cost fields use Wood, Metal, and Glue. Guides and UI also call Glue Goo or Goop; scrap Ghost Pirate corpses into the craft machine for it.
notes.costPolicy: Bonfire 2–7 costs and limit badges prefer Fandom craft UI screenshots. Bonfire 1 and Container Shelter costs come from the Fandom Crafting text table when no UI tile was available. Null means the resource is not required or was not confirmed.
excluded: Unnamed T3 day-multiplier shelter (12 Metal / 20 Wood / 3 Glue)
Unnamed T4 day-multiplier shelter (35 Metal / 40 Wood / 15 Glue)
notes.imagePolicy: Plan icon crops from Fandom craft-tier screenshots for T2–T7; Tier 1 and some unlock props may need secondary screenshots.

item.name: Torch
item.function: Lights the raft base at night.
item.cardSummary: Cheap early light for the raft so you can work and defend after dark without wasting higher-tier crafts.

item.name: Wooden Floor
item.function: Adds walkable floor space to expand the raft.
item.cardSummary: Core foundation piece. Stations and buildings need floor space, so keep a stock of floors as you grow the base.

item.name: Wooden Fence
item.function: Low wood barrier for edges and containment.
item.cardSummary: Light early perimeter piece when you need a cheap edge without spending Metal on stronger walls.

item.name: Wooden Gate
item.function: Wood gate opening for fenced raft sections.
item.cardSummary: Pairs with wooden fences so you can close off parts of the raft without boxing yourself in.

item.name: Wooden Wall
item.function: Solid wood barrier for raft protection.
item.cardSummary: Standard early wall for covering open sides of the raft before metal shell pieces unlock.

item.name: Wooden Window
item.function: Wood wall piece with an opening for sight lines.
item.cardSummary: Same tier cost as a wooden wall when you want a barrier that still lets you see raids or the sea.

item.name: Wooden Stairs
item.function: Straight stairs between raft levels.
item.cardSummary: Main way to stack floors early so you can build upward instead of only outward.

item.name: Corner Stairs
item.function: Corner-turn stairs between raft levels.
item.cardSummary: Use when a straight stair run does not fit and you still need access to a second floor.

item.name: Wooden Door
item.function: Door opening in wood walls for controlled access.
item.cardSummary: Slightly more wood than a plain wall, but it keeps rooms walkable without leaving permanent gaps in the shell.

item.name: Ladder
item.function: Vertical climb between multiple floors.
item.cardSummary: Cheap mid-run vertical access when stairs take too much footprint on a crowded raft.

item.name: Metal Fence
item.function: Stronger metal perimeter for containment.
item.cardSummary: Metal upgrade path for early fences once Wood walls are not enough and you have spare Metal.

item.name: Metal Gate
item.function: Metal gate opening for stronger fenced sections.
item.cardSummary: Matches metal fence cost so you can keep an entry point after upgrading the perimeter.

item.name: Metal Door
item.function: Stronger door for metal shell rooms.
item.cardSummary: Late shell door that keeps metal rooms sealed without leaving permanent openings.

item.name: Metal Window
item.function: Metal wall piece with a viewing opening.
item.cardSummary: Costs more Metal than a solid metal wall tile when you want sight lines through a reinforced shell.

item.name: Metal Wall
item.function: Solid metal barrier for late-run raft protection.
item.cardSummary: Primary reinforced wall once raids hit harder and wood barriers stop feeling safe.

item.name: Cooking Pot
item.function: Cooks food batches into chowder (three ingredients per craft).
item.cardSummary: First real kitchen station. Guides pair it with a Crab Trap so you have ingredients instead of cooking air.

item.name: Crab Trap
item.function: Passive seafood and food drops on a short cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Top early food station. Place one or two after wood income stabilizes so hunger stops owning every trip.

item.name: Pizza Oven
item.function: Cooks food into pizza slices that fill hunger much better than basic meals.
item.unlockNote: Guides report buying the recipe from the Traveling Merchant, then unlocking a glowing object underwater near the raft before you can craft and place it.
item.cardSummary: Best long-term kitchen once unlocked. Expensive wood cost, but pizza removes most of the mid-run hunger grind.

item.name: Tree Plot
item.function: Small on-raft wood farm plot.
item.cardSummary: Early wood helper before you unlock the Sawmill. Useful padding, not a full replacement for floating loot.

item.name: Storage Bin
item.function: On-raft storage container for supplies.
item.cardSummary: Dedicated place to dump materials on the raft so floors and sacks stay cleaner during long runs.

item.name: Sawmill
item.function: Repeatable wood production station (about three planks per use).
item.cardSummary: Core wood engine once Bonfire 3 is up. Low Metal cost and a high place limit make multiple mills normal in co-op.

item.name: Pump Jack
item.function: Converts wood into a large gas canister for fuel crafts.
item.cardSummary: Early fuel station for boat and factory loops. Spend Metal only after Sawmill and food are stable.

item.name: Magnet
item.function: Passive metal collection from the sea when deployed.
item.cardSummary: Hard Metal cap is only two Magnets. Craft both as soon as Bonfire 4 allows so later factories stop stalling.

item.name: Oil Drill
item.function: Converts wood into a gas drum for higher fuel crafts.
item.cardSummary: Upgraded fuel path after Pump Jack. Needs Glue plus heavy Wood, so keep mills and Magnets running first.

item.name: Lightning Rod
item.function: Speeds nearby machines when charged by lightning.
item.unlockNote: Guides report the blueprint comes from clearing the Cargo Ship upper loot route.
item.cardSummary: Place near factories before storms so production bursts when the rod charges instead of sitting idle.

item.name: Ammo Factory
item.function: Turns Metal into random ammo boxes for guns.
item.cardSummary: Main ammo station for raid nights. Guides note it spends Metal per run, so feed it only after Magnets are online.

item.name: Grenade Factory
item.function: Turns a gas drum into grenades.
item.cardSummary: Explosive logistics station for late raids. Needs a fuel pipeline (Pump Jack or Oil Drill) before it is worth the floor space.

item.name: Small Shelter
item.function: Raises the day-count multiplier by 1.
item.cardSummary: Cheapest day-multiplier building. Craft the single allowed copy early so day progress accelerates without a big Metal bill.

item.name: Sundial
item.function: Shows day and night timing on the raft.
item.cardSummary: One-copy utility for tracking the day cycle so night raids and bonfire fuel decisions are less guesswork.

item.name: Radio
item.function: Marks survivor locations on the map.
item.cardSummary: Cheap one-copy station that turns survivor rescues into planned trips instead of blind sailing.

item.name: Container Shelter
item.function: Raises the day-count multiplier by 1.
item.unlockNote: Guides report the blueprint unlocks after clearing the Cargo Ship.
item.cardSummary: Second named day-multiplier shelter. Plan it after the Cargo Ship route instead of expecting it on the first craft menu.

item.name: Map Radar
item.function: Unlocks full map access and island marking.
item.cardSummary: Non-negotiable exploration station once Bonfire 3 is available. One copy opens the map so you stop sailing blind.

item.name: Potion Table
item.function: Brewing station for potions using the recipe book at the table.
item.unlockNote: Becomes craftable at Bonfire Level 3. Place it on empty wooden floor.
item.cardSummary: Station for the potions system, not a potion list. Build after core food and wood stations if you want buffs for raids.

item.name: Galleon Bell
item.function: Spends Glue to temporarily spawn the Ghost Galleon.
item.cardSummary: One-copy summon tool for the Ghost Galleon route. Save Glue for the activation cost after you can already defend the raft.

item.name: Corrupted Portal
item.unlockNote: Appears on the Bonfire 7 craft list. Exact in-run unlock requirements beyond max bonfire are not fully documented in public text guides.
item.cardSummary: Top-tier craft with a heavy Wood and Metal bill. Treat as late endgame until a clearer function note is confirmed in-game.

item.name: Watchtower
item.function: Elevated vantage point for scouting and defense angles.
item.cardSummary: Cheap height for spotting threats and shooting from above without spending Metal on turrets yet.

item.name: Spike Trap
item.function: Defensive trap against hostile entities on the raft.
item.cardSummary: Balanced three-resource trap for choke points when raids start walking onto your floors.

item.name: Cannon
item.function: Player-aimed defensive gun against hostiles.
item.cardSummary: Heavy Metal defense piece for covering approaches before Auto Turrets cover the whole deck.

item.name: Kraken Arm
item.function: Defensive structure against hostile entities.
item.cardSummary: Late defensive craft with a high Glue bill. Place after production and ammo lines are already funded.

item.name: Autoturret
item.function: Fires at enemies with bullets automatically.
item.unlockNote: Also reported for sale from the Traveling Merchant earlier in a run (about 150 Doubloons) once unlocked.
item.cardSummary: Best passive raid defense once available. Craft is expensive; buying early from the merchant can be faster for solo nights.
